key.name: left-capsule
key.summary: Capsule round the bar's left items

key.name: right-capsule
key.summary: Capsule round the bar's right items

key.name: workspace-peek
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. The pointer resting on the left capsule's workspace buttons grows it into glass with a live preview of each workspace: click one to go there, drag a window onto one to move it there.

key.name: workspace-numbers
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. Panel Island's own workspace buttons in the left capsule, one per workspace: click one to go there, drop a window or an app icon on one.

key.name: drag-to-workspaces
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. A window moved by its title bar, or an app icon, held over the left capsule opens the workspace peek; let go on a preview or a number, it goes to that workspace.

key.name: peek-delay
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. How long the pointer rests on a workspace button before the peek opens, in milliseconds.

key.name: attention-glow
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. The left capsule's edge glows in the accent colour while a window on another workspace asks for attention.

key.name: glow-width
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. How wide the glowing line round the capsule is, in pixels; a soft glow reaches a little further in.

key.name: attention-pulse
key.description: Moved to Island Menu, which reads it once to keep your setting. The glow slowly breathes in and out instead of staying lit.

key.name: keep-activities
key.description: Show GNOME's own Activities button (its workspace dots) again when another extension hides it, such as O-tiling's workspace numbers.

key.name: centre-capsule
key.summary: Capsule round the bar's middle items (the clock)
key.description: auto: only while Isle is not on, its island holding the clock otherwise.

key.name: top-bar
key.summary: The top bar's colour while Isle is off
key.description: isle: as Isle's own Settings colour it (without Isle, as top-bar-opacity says). custom: as top-bar-opacity says. theme: the theme's own.

key.name: top-bar-opacity
key.description: How black the top bar is while Isle is off, in %: 0 see-through, 100 black.

key.name: switch-glass
key.description: always: the glass held still as a workspace switch slides (it blurs again once it is over), much lighter on the CPU. battery: held still on battery only, live on mains. never: the glass follows the slide live. live-efficient: the shared blur follows every frame at half resolution.

key.name: color-style
key.description: auto: light or dark as GNOME's own style is (Settings → Appearance). light: frosted light glass, dark text and icons. dark: the glass as Isle's. The menus opened on the capsules follow it too, whatever GNOME's own style.

key.name: shape
key.description: "isle": as Isle's island (its own Shape setting). "pill": floating in the bar, round all over. "notch": joined to the top of the screen, flaring into the bar.

key.name: theme
key.description: "isle": as Isle's island (its own Island setting). "glass": blurred glass with Isle's glass tint. "black": solid black.

key.name: reach-edges
key.description: The left capsule runs to the screen's left edge and the right one to its right edge, menus opening joined to it.

key.name: edge-radius
key.summary: The bottom corner at the screen's edge, in px
key.description: With reach-edges: positive rounds it in, 0 leaves it square, negative flares it out concave down the screen's side.

key.name: edge-corners
key.summary: Old: which corners at the screen's edge edge-radius shapes
key.description: Replaced by top-same-as-bottom and the top-… keys; carried over once (migrate.js).

key.name: match-windows
key.description: With reach-edges: a closed capsule's bottom corner at the screen's edge is sized from the rounded corner of a window right below the bar, edge-radius's sign picking the way: positive as round as it, negative flared, following it at an even gap, 0 square.

key.name: window-radius-auto
key.summary: Window corner radius from Rounded Window Corners
key.description: Its own corner radius if it is installed, else libadwaita's (15 px).

key.name: window-radius
key.summary: Window corner radius, in px (with window-radius-auto off)

key.name: edge-light
key.summary: How the glass's edge catches the light
key.description: "even": the same all round, straight edges and corners alike. "directional": as Isle's, lit from the top left, so edges facing down and left (a corner turning that way) are hardly lit.

key.name: top-same-as-bottom
key.summary: The top corner at the screen's edge as the bottom one
key.description: On: the top corner takes the bottom's radius and window matching. Off: the top-… keys below.

key.name: top-edge-radius
key.summary: The top corner at the screen's edge, in px
key.description: With top-same-as-bottom off: positive rounds it in, 0 leaves it square, negative flares it out concave up the screen's side (into the room above).

key.name: top-match-windows
key.summary: The top corner rounded as the windows' corners
key.description: With top-same-as-bottom off: the top corner sized as a window's corner, top-edge-radius's sign picking the way: positive round, negative flared, 0 square.

key.name: top-window-radius-auto
key.summary: For the top corner, the window corner radius from Rounded Window Corners

key.name: top-window-radius
key.summary: For the top corner, the window corner radius, in px (with top-window-radius-auto off)

key.name: patch-isle-overview
key.summary: Keep Isle's glass in the overview
key.description: Isle's island hides its blur in the overview, almost clear there. On: Isle's glass is changed as it runs (its files are not) to stay, blurring the wallpaper. Off, or if Isle has changed so this cannot apply, Isle is as it is.

key.name: patch-isle-corners
key.description: Isle's glass takes its rim, glow and lens from its body alone, so a notch's shoulders look drawn on apart. On: Isle's glass is cut with this extension's mask as it runs (its files are not changed), its whole outline taken. Off, or if Isle has changed so this cannot apply, Isle is as it is.

key.name: edge-blur
key.summary: The glass at the screen's edge
key.description: "fade": as Isle's, the blur thinning into clear glass towards the screen's edge. "solid": as solid up to the edge as anywhere.

key.name: isle-weather
key.description: A chip beside the day with its sky and temperature, and, clicked, the day's weather in full in place of the events: Isle's own feature/calendar-weather branch, added to Isle as it runs (its files are not changed). For GNOME Weather's place; needs GNOME Weather. Off, or if Isle has changed so this cannot apply, Isle is as it is.

key.name: isle-edge-blur
key.summary: Isle's glass at the screen's edge
key.description: With patch-isle-corners on (Isle's glass then cut by this extension's mask): "fade" as Isle draws it, its blur thinning into clear glass towards the screen's edge; "solid" as blurred up to the edge as anywhere.

key.name: patch-isle-light
key.description: Isle's island light too when Panel Island's Style is light: its glass, fill, text and icons, done to Isle as it runs and never to its files. What Isle paints in code (rings, its bot) stays as Isle draws it.

key.name: patch-isle-lighter
key.description: Isle's glass copies every window its blur reaches, a margin below the bar too, so a window there (a video in it) has it blurred again every frame. On: only windows under the glass itself are copied, as for this extension's own glass. Changed as Isle runs, its files are not; off, or if Isle has changed so this cannot apply, Isle is as it is.

key.name: island-panel-from
key.description: The capsule Island Menu's launcher grows out of: 'left' (its own capsule), or 'centre', the middle one, the launcher centred under (or, with the bar at the bottom, above) it. Only the launcher: the workspace peek stays with the left capsule. While the middle capsule is not shown (Settings → Middle capsule), the left one.

key.name: clock-enabled
key.description: A clock of its own in the left or the middle capsule (clock-capsule), in the style clock-style says, whatever hides GNOME's clock. Clicking it opens GNOME's calendar. Off: none, GNOME's clock as it is.

key.name: clock-hide-gnome
key.description: While the capsule clock shows, GNOME's own clock is hidden, so the time shows once (its calendar opens from the capsule clock). Off: GNOME's clock left as it is, shown or hidden by whatever else says (Top Bar Organizer, Isle).

key.name: clock-event-chip
key.description: Before an event with a time of day (not a whole-day one) in GNOME's calendar, its name and how soon ("Standup · 12 min") beside the clock, from clock-event-lead minutes before it until a minute after it starts.

key.name: clock-event-lead
key.description: Minutes before an event its chip shows.

key.name: clock-notify-badge
key.description: While notifications wait (as GNOME's own dot counts them, none with Do Not Disturb): dot, a small dot right of the time; count, how many; off, nothing. The clock's panel opens them from its top row either way.

key.name: clock-capsule
key.description: left: at the end of the bar's left box, in the left capsule. centre: first in the bar's middle box, in the middle capsule (with the bar at the top, under Isle's island when Isle has it there).

key.name: clock-style
key.description: flip: flip digits, a changed digit flipping over. sun: the time beside a sun (or moon) on an arc across the day.

key.name: clock-flip-meridiem
key.summary: AM and PM with flip digits
key.description: stacked: AM over PM, the one it is lit. tile: a flip tile of its own. Only with a 12-hour clock.

key.name: clock-sun-label
key.summary: AM or PM after the time (sun)
key.description: With the sun style and a 12-hour clock: a small AM or PM after the time. Off: the arc alone tells (morning on its left, evening on its right).

key.name: clock-show-date
key.description: The day and date, softer, after the time.

key.name: clock-scroll
key.description: Scrolling over the clock shows the date and week, then the first of your world clocks, for a few seconds.

key.name: clock-sun-colours
key.description: The sun style follows the day: golden before sunset, blue at dusk and dawn, a moon at night, from the weather place's sunrise and sunset. Off: drawn in the bar's text colour.

key.name: clock-dnd
key.description: A small moon after the time while notifications are silenced.

key.name: clock-copy
key.description: Right click on the clock copies the date and time (and no longer opens the calendar).

key.name: weather-enabled
key.description: The weather (GNOME's own, for GNOME Weather's place) in the left or the middle capsule: its icon and temperature; its menu the next twelve hours. Hidden while there is no weather to show.

key.name: weather-capsule
key.description: left: at the end of the bar's left box. centre: at the end of its middle box.

key.name: weather-glass
key.description: Its capsule's glass takes on the sky: drops of rain, frost when it is cold, a warm glare in sun, mist in fog, a few stars on a clear night. Drawn once as the sky changes, never moving.

key.name: weather-words
key.description: The sky in words ("Partly cloudy") after the temperature.

key.name: weather-rain-chip
key.description: Before rain, when it is due ("Rain ~4 PM"), from the hourly forecast, up to three hours ahead.

key.name: bar-at-bottom
key.description: GNOME's top bar moved to the bottom of the main display, the capsules and their menus' glass with it, menus opening upwards. Isle's island stays at the top of the screen, hanging from it as on a display with no bar (Isle does this itself; nothing of Isle's is changed). Off: the bar is where GNOME puts it.

key.name: patch-isle-calm
key.description: Isle's island grows and shrinks on springs that overshoot a little and spring back. On: they are damped just enough not to (as Isle's own corners are), as quick to arrive. Changed as Isle runs, its files are not; off, or if Isle has changed so this cannot apply, Isle is as it is.

key.name: tint-like-isle
key.description: On: the glass tint follows Isle's own Glass tint setting. Off: glass-tint below.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: With the Glass look and tint-like-isle off: from 0 (clear, lightly blurred) to 100 (dark frosted glass, blurred most), as Isle's Glass tint.

key.name: open-on
key.description: "isle": as Isle's island opens (its own setting and delay). "hover": when the pointer rests on a button. "click": only when clicked.

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: How long the pointer rests before a menu opens, in milliseconds (with "hover")

key.name: close-delay
key.summary: How long after the pointer leaves a menu opened on hover it closes, in milliseconds

key.name: animation-speed
key.summary: How fast the glass grows and shrinks (1 is normal, 2 twice as fast)

key.name: bounce
key.summary: A little overshoot as a menu opens

key.name: centre-menus
key.summary: Centre a menu in its glass

key.name: flat-buttons
key.summary: No hover or pressed shading on the side buttons
